date.description: Date the estimate was issued, YYYY-MM-DD

business.description: The party issuing the estimate. All fields optional placeholders if unknown.

title.description: Short job title, e.g. "Kitchen faucet replacement"

location.description: Job site address, if different from client address

unit.description: e.g. hr, ea, sq ft, ls (lump sum)

total.description: quantity * unit_cost. Recomputed by build_estimate.py, not trusted from input.

tax_rate.description: Percent, e.g. 7.5 for 7.5%. Omit or 0 if not taxable.

discount.description: Flat amount subtracted from subtotal before tax.

subtotal.description: Recomputed by build_estimate.py, not trusted from input.

tax_amount.description: Recomputed by build_estimate.py, not trusted from input.

total.description: Recomputed by build_estimate.py, not trusted from input.

notes.description: Assumptions made, items flagged for client confirmation, scope exclusions.
